name: Centrum De Haan (Bussum)
reason: Too thin once the health rule is applied: centrumdehaan.nl (robots.txt allows us; Divine Life Society branch, Bussum) is a yoga and naturopathy practice whose menu is half therapies (naturopathy, homeopathy, Bach flowers, breath therapy, manual and relationship therapy, aura healing), all left out. What remains current is weekly yoga classes (from €47.50 a month); the satsang is paused, workshop pages show 2022 dates, the November silent retreat is past, and the four-year teacher training is closed to new students until March 2027. Email info@centrumdehaan.nl is published. Could be revisited in spring 2027.
